g.text: Risk classification — how agent, model and MCP-server bands relate to the AI use case
The use case classification sets the bounds. A resource classification is checked against them — it does not sum into them.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(237, 231, 246), rgb(39, 34, 46)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(94, 53, 177), rgb(197, 161, 255));

g.text: GOVERNANCE INTAKE & RISK TRIAGE
owns the use-case classification and every re-classification

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(94, 53, 177), rgb(197, 161, 255));

g.text: Use-case intake
pre-populated from the exported use-case pack — not blank

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(94, 53, 177), rgb(197, 161, 255));

g.text: Risk triage — CMRM questionnaire
Impact-led: worst credible outcome for a person.
5 impact + 7 likelihood questions → AA / A / B / C / D.
Inherent — scored before any control is credited.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(94, 53, 177), rgb(197, 161, 255));

g.text: Explicit risk approval
A band the platform computes is a proposal until this lands

g.text: Re-classification happens here — not in the control plane
OPEN — does a breached agent trigger a use-case
re-classification, or must the use case move first?

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(245, 249, 255), rgb(21, 24, 29)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(21, 101, 192), rgb(99, 168, 246));

g.text: AGENTIC CONTROL PLANE
computes and publishes bands · never decides the rigor they require

g.text: AI USE CASE
= a platform project
use-case band (low … critical)
APM ref · governance intake ref
This band is the ceiling every
resource inside must sit under.

g.text: GAP — the platform does not sweep or band a project.
The band can be stored on it; nothing enforces it.

g.text: Agent
autonomy · tools bound · destructive capability · data reach
credentials · MCP servers bound · delegation

OSFI E-23 model risk tier · region · approval state

g.text: MCP server
data classification · PII / PCI / government data
destructive tools · inbound auth · outbound credentials
A different instrument at each level. The use case asks what could happen to a person;
a resource asks what it can reach and what authority it holds.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(55, 71, 79), rgb(167, 181, 188));

g.text: CONTAINMENT CHECK
Is each resource band at or below
the use-case band?
Runs continuously, not once at intake.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(232, 245, 233), rgb(21, 33, 22)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(46, 125, 50), rgb(100, 168, 104));

g.text: Within bounds — no action

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 235, 238), rgb(44, 27, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(198, 40, 40), rgb(255, 145, 145));

g.text: Above bounds — divergence finding
The agent grew past what the use case
was assessed for. The control plane raises it;
governance decides whether to re-classify.

g.text: WHEN A BAND BITES
Classification runs everywhere from the start. What changes by environment is whether it blocks.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(46, 125, 50), rgb(100, 168, 104));

g.text: DEV · SIT — observe
Self-serve. Bands are computed and recorded; nothing is denied.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 248, 225), rgb(30, 24, 4)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(249, 168, 37), rgb(149, 79, 0));

g.text: PROMOTION GATE
Export the pack → pre-populate intake → approval → obligations for the target band.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(198, 40, 40), rgb(255, 145, 145));

g.text: STAGE · PROD — enforce
A resource outside its use case's bounds does not run.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(251, 246, 246), rgb(29, 24, 24)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(239, 211, 211), rgb(70, 46, 46));

g.text: INHERENT RISK, AND CONTROLS KEPT SEPARATE FROM IT
Model risk is tracked on an inherent basis — scored independently of the controls, with controls carried alongside as mitigations.
A control must never quietly lower a band, or the register stops showing what is actually being run.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(198, 40, 40), rgb(255, 145, 145));

g.text: INHERENT — what it could do
data reach · autonomy · destructive capability · external exposure · regulatory scope · model tier
This alone produces the band.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(46, 125, 50), rgb(100, 168, 104));

g.text: CONTROLS — carried, not netted off
registration + ownership · inbound authentication · human review · evaluations · guardrails
Tracked as mitigations against the obligations the band demands.
